column3: NKJV has “your own Master,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “both their Master and yours.”
NKJV includes “my brethren,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
NKJV has “the rulers of the darkness of this age,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the world rulers of this darkness.”
